questions: When the board is fully visible, does it hold exactly three pens arranged in a single row?
Are all three pens aligned identically, all pointing the same way, including any pen near the left or right frame edge as it enters or exits?
Do all three pens share identical barrel and cap colors, with no mismatch?
Is every pen fully capped with no exposed writing tip, and are all three pens equal in length?
Does the board advance steadily from left to right at EVERY moment, never halting, freezing, or pausing even briefly (1-3 seconds) at any point in the video?
Do all pens stay fixed in their positions on the board, with no pen shifting, sliding, or moving on its own relative to the board mid-clip?

question_answers.evidence: From frame 7 onwards, when the board is fully visible, there are clearly three pens arranged in a row.
The middle pen is oriented with its cap at the top, while the left and right pens are oriented with their caps at the bottom. They are not all pointing the same way.
All three pens have translucent barrels and black caps/ends, appearing identical in color.
All pens appear to have their caps on and are of similar length.
The board translates smoothly from the left side of the frame to the right across the sequence without visible stopping or jamming.
The relative positions of the pens on the board remain constant throughout the clip.

parsed.reason: The middle pen is flipped relative to the other two pens (cap up vs caps down), violating the condition that all pens must point the same direction.

description: One pen is flipped 180 degrees relative to the other two.
